Bend.description: A bend: the string pushed up by `semitones` after the note starts.

release.description: Let back down to the fretted pitch before the note ends.

semitones.description: How far up, in semitones: 1 is a half step, 2 a whole step.

HeardNote.description: A note as transcription heard it: a pitch and a time in seconds, not yet on a beat or a string.

bend.description: The furthest the pitch moved from `pitch` while it sounded, in semitones: a bend when positive. 0 when it held still.

onset.description: Seconds after the tab's tick 0 that it starts.

pitch.description: The MIDI note it started on.

Instrument.description: What the tab is for. It sets how many strings it may have.

TabNote.description: One note: where it is played, when, and how.

bend.description: A bend up, and whether it comes back down.

dead.description: A dead note: the string muted by the fretting hand, a click with no pitch. Written as an x.

fret.description: The fret, counted from the capo; 0 is the open string.

hammerOn.description: Sounded by hammering onto the fret from the note before.

harmonic.description: A natural harmonic, touched over the fret rather than pressed.

letRing.description: Left ringing past its length, into the notes after it.

palmMute.description: Damped with the picking hand at the bridge.

pullOff.description: Sounded by pulling off to this fret from the note before.

slide.description: Slides into the next note on the same string.

start.description: Ticks from the start of the tab, 960 per quarter note.

velocity.description: How hard it was played, 0 to 1.

Tempo.description: Tempo and time signature. One of each for the whole timeline for now; the engine's tempo map can hold changes, and when the UI can edit them this grows into a list.

denominator.description: The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes.

description: A guitar or bass part as strings and frets: the tuning, the capo, the tempo the notes were written against, and the notes with their techniques. Strings count from 1, the highest-pitched; frets count from the capo; times are ticks, 960 per quarter note, from the start of the tab.

capo.description: The fret the capo is at; 0 for none.

heard.description: For a transcribed tab, the notes as transcription heard them, before they were quantized to the grid and fitted to strings, so either can be redone without transcribing again. Empty for a tab written by hand.

instrument.description: Guitar or bass, which sets how many strings it may have.

name.description: Shown above the tab and in exports.

tempo.description: The tempo and time signature the ticks were written against.

tuning.description: The open strings from the lowest to the highest, as MIDI notes (40 is the low E of a guitar). Its length is the string count.
